array.string: CFG="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cursor-ollama-gateway"; LOGROOT="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/cursor-ollama-gateway/logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGROOT"; exec >>"$LOGROOT/ngrok-ollama.out.log" 2>&1; source "$CFG/.env" && exec "$(command -v ngrok)" start --config "$CFG/ngrok.yml" cursor-ollama
